problem_text: Match the following strengths and weaknesses to their respective categories: 1. AI can process large amounts of data quickly. 2. Human creativity can bring unique perspectives. 3. AI might lack emotional depth in content. 4. Humans can adapt to nuanced situations better.

solution.option: AI can process large amounts of data quickly.
Human creativity can bring unique perspectives.
AI might lack emotional depth in content.
Humans can adapt to nuanced situations better.
